moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio tx-particle-text, written here): Points sampled from the text raster (80 px black, step ≈3 px, odd rows offset), drawn as 2 px squares. Gather: each flies from a seeded spot to its place in 0.9 s expo.out, start 0.2 + 0–0.35 s, opacity 0.35 → 1, ±0.4 px noise. Cursor crosses right → left 1.9–3.6 s on a ±30 px sine: points within 38 px are pushed out ((1 − d/38)², ≤ 34 px) through a spring (ω 10, ζ 0.45) and turn accent. Exit 4.55 s + 0–0.25 s: back to scatter 0.6 s power2.in. Loop 5.4 s. Params: bước lấy mẫu (3 px) · bán kính đẩy (38 px) · thời gian kết (0.9 s).
